Book correction: The answer key prints only \sqrt{-3} for 1(b)(i). That is not a real number: -3 is outside the domain x \ge -\frac{3}{2} of f(x) = \sqrt{2x + 3}, so f(-3) is not defined in real numbers. The complete answer is "f(-3) = \sqrt{-3}, not a real number; f(-3) does not exist for real x".
